title: Holographic Entanglement and Emergent Gravity
summary: We investigate the emergence of bulk geometry from boundary entanglement entropy in the context of holographic duality. Considering a thermal $1+1$-dimensional conformal field theory dual to the BTZ black hole, we compute four distinct holographic entanglement measures: the standard spacelike HEE, its complementary spacelike counterpart HEE$^s$, the timelike HTEE and its complementary timelike counterpart HEE$^t$.
